trigger_condition: Activity text falls below the fixed y=790 crop in a header-matching PDF.
guard_snippet: Validate geometry/excluded regions and add a shifted-layout fixture.
potential_consequence: Unsupported shifted layouts can omit activities without a source uncertainty warning.

trigger_condition: A small compressed PDF expands to excessive parsing memory.
guard_snippet: Consider worker memory bounds and bounded adversarial fixtures.
potential_consequence: Byte/page/output/time limits alone do not establish a worker memory bound.

trigger_condition: Upload and extraction each fit their server stage limits but jointly exceed the browser's 45-second budget.
guard_snippet: Make aggregate deadline policy explicit and verify a slow combined path.
potential_consequence: The UI may cancel a request still within individual server-stage budgets.

trigger_condition: One owner occupies both global import slots.
guard_snippet: Consider per-owner admission if multi-user service becomes a requirement.
potential_consequence: Other owners can receive import-busy responses during repeated slow imports.

trigger_condition: Repeated cancelled reviews accumulate 200 pending operations.
guard_snippet: Consider reuse or explicit retirement while preserving retry identities.
potential_consequence: The owner reaches the documented admission bound until operations expire.

trigger_condition: Draft physical_bus contains NUL, unlike the later current-bus contract which rejects it.
guard_snippet: Align draft/client representability validation and assert rejection before JSONB persistence.
potential_consequence: A valid-shaped draft request reaches storage failure rather than a field-validation response.

trigger_condition: An update changes import_metadata, including retained source facts.
guard_snippet: Preserve the existing comparison baseline independently or reject metadata changes on imported-draft updates.
potential_consequence: A new valid update can replace facts presented as preserved original interpretation.

trigger_condition: Deadhead/CAR has no trip number: the renderer calls it unknown but review does not include that fact in acknowledgements.
guard_snippet: Define and test one explicit per-type required/acknowledged/irrelevant field matrix.
potential_consequence: The displayed unknown set and confirmation acknowledgement set differ.

trigger_condition: Service date differs substantially from activity calendar dates.
guard_snippet: Consider an explicit mismatch warning while allowing legitimate independent calendar dates.
potential_consequence: An accidental date mismatch can be confirmed alongside visibly different calendar dates.

trigger_condition: Another window saves a bus while this window remains open without edits.
guard_snippet: Consider explicit refresh/revalidation that preserves pending local state.
potential_consequence: The open view retains its last read bus until reopening or a checked write.
